title: Global financial crisis of 2008
summary: The crisis grew from the US housing market, the epicenter of what the Federal Reserve calls the Great Recession, which lasted from December 2007 to June 2009, the longest US downturn since the Second World War. After the collapse of Lehman Brothers in mid-September 2008 it intensified sharply. The IMF warned that its reach into all corners of the world economy posed a threat to global prosperity not seen in 70 years.

uncertainty.note: US recession began in December 2007 and troughed in June 2009; systemic acute phase erupted with the collapse of Lehman Brothers in September 2008.
